---
title: "Figure 1I-1L"
output: html_notebook
---

Download libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

Download RData from the folder.
```{r}
# Load RData file containing data required for analysis and visualization.
load("multiple_cohorts_data.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)

```


Cohort NSCLC Pre-Tx 50% IRF2 - Plot survival curves.
```{r}
df_NSCLC_N124 <- df_pre %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre")

Fig1_NSCLC_P50 <- plot_km_high_low(df_NSCLC_N124,
                 value_col = "IRF2", 
                 split_pct = 50,
                 norm_type = "log2", 
                 show_metrics = "median", 
                 landmark_years = 1,
                 title = "Cohort NSCLC",
                 plot_title_suffix = "IRF2: Top vs. Bottom 50% ")

```

Cohort NSCLC Pre-Tx IRF2 50% - Calculate OS Diff.
```{r}
compute_median_os_diff(df_NSCLC_N124, 
                       group_col = "Group", 
                       time_col = "OS_Time",
                       status_col = "OS_Status",
                       max_years = NULL,
                       group_high = "High", 
                       group_low = "Low",
                       value_col = "IRF2", 
                       split_pct = 50,
                       norm_type = "log2") 
```

Cohort NSCLC Pre-Tx IRF2 - Plot KM tailcuts.
```{r}
Fig1_NSCLC_tails <- plot_km_tailcut(df_NSCLC_N124, 
                value_col = "IRF2", 
                cut_pcts = c(50, 35, 15),
                side = "High", 
                norm_type = "log2",
                title = "Cohort NSCLC: IRF2")

```


```{r}
Fig1I_L <- ggarrange(Fig1_NSCLC_P50$plot, 
                  Fig1_NSCLC_P35$plot, 
                  Fig1_NSCLC_P15$plot, 
                  Fig1_NSCLC_tails$plot,
          nrow = 2, ncol = 2)

Fig1I_L
```
